title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is developing a general 'reconstruction' lemma for a category C from a full subcategory A. The lemma is a side tool in notes on dévissage of ∂-perfect semi-simplicial complexes, presumably for describing categories of perfect objects by generators.

The previous page gives the covariant form. The restricted Yoneda functor r: C → Â = Hom(A°, Ens) is X ↦ Hom(−,X)|_A. In the additive case it lands in Â_ab, the additive contravariant functors. If every object of C is a colimit of a given type of objects of A, r is fully faithful. Its essential image is then the presheaves that are such colimits of representables, with equality if C is stable under those colimits. The additive special case: if C is additive and every object is a finite direct sum of objects of A, then C is equivalent to the finite direct sums of representables in Â_ab.

This page, first paragraph (end of that example): if A consists of a single object A with endomorphism ring k, then X ↦ Hom(A,X) gives an equivalence of C with finitely generated free right k-modules. k acts on Hom(A,X) by precomposition, hence on the right. This is the elementary Morita/additive-Yoneda statement.

Second paragraph: 'Transformons par dualité'. If every object of C is a limit of objects of A, the canonical functor r°: C° → Â° = Hom(A, Ens) (resp. Hom(A, Ab)), X ↦ Hom(X,−)|_A, is fully faithful. If every object is a limit of certain types of objects of A, the essential image lies in the full subcategory of covariant functors A → Ens (resp. Ab) that are colimits of the corresponding types of corepresentables. The page states 'limites', which is the dual variance. The image equals that subcategory if C is stable under limits of that type (continued on the next page).

Next page: combining both statements gives a 'two-sided' proposition. Suppose C is stable under limits of type T and colimits of type T′, and every object is both a T-limit and a T′-colimit of objects of A. Then C is equivalent both to the T-limits of representables in Â and (contravariantly) to the T′-colimits of corepresentables in Hom(A, Ens).
errors: As literally stated, 'every object of C is a limit (resp. colimit) of objects of A ⇒ the restricted (co)Yoneda functor is fully faithful' is false. Fullness needs the presenting (co)limit to be preserved by the restricted Yoneda functor. For r° this means Hom(lim A_i, B) = colim Hom(A_i, B) for B in A, e.g. when the limit is the canonical one, i.e. A is codense. Counterexample (covariant, Set-valued): A = {Z} in Ab. Every abelian group is a colimit of copies of Z, but X ↦ Hom(Z,X) into Z-sets for the multiplicative monoid of Z is not full. Non-additive maps commute with multiplication by integers. In the additive (Ab-enriched) version, or for absolute (co)limits such as finite biproducts as in the examples given, the statement is correct.
Minor: the variance of 'limites' in the description of the essential image of r° has to be read in Â° (colimits of corepresentables in Hom(A,Ens)); the wording mixes C° and C.

ideas.what: Restricted Yoneda embedding C → Â is fully faithful when objects are (suitable) colimits of objects of A; essential image = such colimits of representables
ideas.modern_name: Dense subcategory / density theorem; Isbell 'adequate' subcategory
ideas.where_published: Related material in SGA 4 Exp. I (presheaves as colimits of representables, ind-objects)

ideas.what: Dual: codense subcategory, X ↦ Hom(X,−)|_A fully faithful into copresheaves, image = limits of corepresentables
ideas.where_published: Pro-objects in SGA 4 Exp. I / FGA are related

ideas.what: Additive category whose objects are finite sums of one object A with End(A)=k is equivalent to finitely generated free right k-modules via Hom(A,−)
ideas.modern_name: Additive Yoneda / elementary Morita theory (add(A) ≃ free f.g. End(A)-modules)

ideas.what: Simultaneous description of C as limit-closure of representables and colimit-closure of corepresentables (next page's proposition)
ideas.modern_name: Two-sided density, cf. Isbell duality / Gabriel–Ulmer-type characterizations

deep.surprise_reason: Standard density/codensity and additive Yoneda statements, stated somewhat loosely, as a routine auxiliary lemma; nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'Si A objet de C est limite d'objets de A' should read 'Si ∀ objet de C est lim. d'objets de A' (the symbol is ∀, not A); likewise 'Si de plus, ∀ objet de C est limite de certains types d'objets de A' (the last A is the subcategory, likely script A).
First line likely: '(Si A est réduite à un objet A, d'anneau d'endomorphismes k ... , on trouve une équivalence avec la cat. des k-modules à droite libres de type fini, par X ↦ Hom(A,X))'.
'Transformations par dualité en caract.' likely 'Transformons par dualité ce qui précède' (or similar).
'Hom(A, Ens)' / 'Hom(A, Ab)' are underlined functor categories Hom(A, Ens), Hom(A, Ab), the covariant functors on the subcategory A.
End of page: 'et l'image essentielle est égale à cette dernière catégorie si [C est stable sous les limites projectives de ce type]'.
